tasks.title: Liquidity Hazard & Canonical Actionability Enforcement (GAP-WS41-003)
acceptance_criteria: AC-LIQ-01: Extend DecisionHierarchyEngine.resolve_decision_state() with an optional execution_hazard: bool parameter (defaulting to False when evidence is unavailable, while enforcing fail-closed actionability).

AC-LIQ-02: Enforce Precedence in DecisionHierarchyEngine: If execution_hazard is True, the setup MUST be disqualified from ACTIONABLE_SETUP, setting state=VALID_SETUP, isActionable=False, canSizeTrade=False, label='Valid Setup — Liquidity Hazard', and allowedActions=['ADD_WATCHLIST', 'RESEARCH_PROFILE'].
AC-LIQ-03: Set disqualificationReason to explicit liquidity warning: 'Trade execution suppressed: Severe liquidity hazard detected (ADV / slippage friction exceeds safety threshold).'
AC-LIQ-04: Wire execution_hazard from OptimalExecutionEngine raw_plan['liquidity_defense']['execution_hazard'] into api/routes/analytics.py, api/routes/screener.py, and DecisionTraceEngine.
AC-LIQ-05: Preserve F_10 governance invariant: Missing liquidity evidence (UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN) must fail closed without synthesizing fictitious zero-hazard fallbacks.
AC-LIQ-06: Strict separation invariant: STOPPED_OUT price-floor invalidation and execution_hazard liquidity friction must remain distinct, non-conflated precedence branches.
negative_regression_tests: NEG-LIQ-01: Micro-cap illiquid fixture (ADV $85k, Amihud 4.2) with confluence 88.0 inside buy zone strictly produces isActionable=False and canSizeTrade=False.
NEG-LIQ-02: Illiquid setup suppresses position sizing in GovernorSizingEngine with 0 shares.
NEG-LIQ-03: Missing volume profile (None) produces execution_hazard=True (fail-closed) and blocks ACTIONABLE_SETUP.
NEG-LIQ-04: Setup with execution_hazard=True and execution_status=STOPPED_OUT produces label 'Setup Invalidated — Stopped Out' (STOPPED_OUT takes precedence over liquidity friction).
tasks.description: Enforce liquidity defense and execution hazard friction in canonical decision hierarchy. Prevents severely illiquid stocks from transitioning to ACTIONABLE_SETUP regardless of technical pattern quality. Verified in WS4.2 frontend presentation.
